inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Claude model alias used for both the audit and per-finding filter.

inputs.name: excludeDirectories
inputs.description: Comma-separated repository directories excluded with upstream prefix/segment semantics.

inputs.name: customSecurityScanInstructions
inputs.description: Optional repository-relative file containing extra audit categories.

inputs.name: falsePositiveFilteringInstructions
inputs.description: Optional repository-relative file replacing the default per-finding filter policy.

inputs.name: maxDiffBytes
inputs.description: Optional filtered-diff limit; defaults to the engine prompt-file cap.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Trusted deterministic preparation, filtering, collection, and report runtime.
